errors.text: The initial state is incorrectly described as pre-existing CoCrFeNiTi alloy powder rather than nominally equimolar elemental Co, Cr, Fe, Ni, and Ti powders.
The proposed SPS heating rate of greater than 100°C/min conflicts with the target rate of 50°C/min, while key milling and sintering parameters are omitted.
Comparing nanoindentation hardness at two loads cannot distinguish Hall–Petch strengthening from solute strengthening; indentation size effects are not a direct test of grain-size causality.
